correctness.rationale: Geometric normal form is valid for every smooth conic over F5. The checker exhaustively enumerates all 60 dihedral hexagon classes, independently computes all Pascal cross products and third-point collinearity, and reconstructs all 120 PGL2(F5) maps and their 30/20/10 orbits. Three orbit representatives give exterior line equations with nonsquare discriminants, PGL2-transitivity gives surjection and uniform 3+2+1 fibers; full enumeration confirms 10 lines each with six preimages. All 31 rational plane points and 45 pairs of exterior lines yield 15 double and 10 triple intersections; extension-field zeta expressions are deduced algebraically by inclusion-exclusion, not guessed from experiments. No claim about flat scheme lengths.

value.rationale: The unique full rational sextuple on a conic over the five-element field is a canonical, non-arbitrary arithmetic specialization of the classical hexagrammum mysticum. The dramatic 60-to-10 coincidence is a complete classification of its Pascal map, with a group-theoretic orbit refinement that connects classical Pascal geometry to the known Desargues arrangement of ten nonsecant lines. It gives a motivated boundary for characteristic-zero coincidence results. The separate incidence/zeta formulas are consequences and not inflated into independent discoveries.
